name: user_team
label: Group Member Relationship Table
description: Group membership table for querying, filtering, and reporting related framework data.

fields.name: id
fields.description: Auto-incremented ID. A standard index is defined on this field, making it suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

fields.name: team_uuid
fields.description: Retrieve the UUID of the flow_team, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: user_uuid
fields.description: Retrieve the UUID of the flow_user, used as the primary key or unique identifier for records in this table.

fields.name: title
fields.description: Title, such as team leader or deputy team leader.

indexes.name: PRIMARY
indexes.description: Primary key index covering the team_uuid, user_uuid fields, suitable for uniquely identifying records and queries that join the primary table.

indexes.name: id
indexes.description: Standard index covering the ID field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_flow_team_uuid
indexes.description: Standard index covering the team_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.

indexes.name: idx_flow_user_team
indexes.description: Standard index covering the user_uuid field, suitable for filtering, join, and sort queries.
